headline: Mooring County Erupts Into Fresh Turmoil as Callum's Cape Carnage Escalates
war_summary: Mooring County has surged back to the forefront with seven base changes in the past two hours amidst massive attritional bloodshed around The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast. In Callum's Cape, casualty rates have sharply accelerated to over two thousand men an hour as the contest for Naofa and Scout's Jest reaches a fever pitch, despite a brief lull in fresh line transitions. Meanwhile, the furious base-swapping that rocked Linn of Mercy and Weathered Expanse earlier in the night has cooled considerably; Linn of Mercy's firing line went abruptly quiet following early morning skirmishing at Outwich Ranch, while Weathered Expanse settled into steady positional attrition after Crow's Nest changed hands around midnight. Along the secondary sectors, fighting in Marban Hollow and the maritime reaches remains subdued, leaving the western highlands of Callum's Cape and Mooring County as the focal points of the war's grinding momentum.
